subject: RStan: single elements are not coerced to arrays of length 1

messages.author: 216b106619b6f746
messages.subject: RStan: single elements are not coerced to arrays of length 1
parts:
Hi All

I've just come across the following and was wondering if its a bug. I'm
using a fairly recent development version of RStan from git and do not
know if the behaviour is the same in the latest official release.

Suppose the data block contains
int n;
int x[n];

one can then sample from R using, for example,
data=list(n=3,x=c(1,2,3))
however one cannot do
data=list(n=1,x=2)
as this gives an error "mismatch in number dimensions declared and
found...".
Instead it is necessary to have
data=list(n=1,x=array(2))

In other words R vectors of length >1 are automatically coerced into
suitable Stan arrays but vectors of length 1 are not coerced. This is
rather inconvenient as its forced me to call the R array function on a
number of vectors in my data just to handle the case that they have
length 1.

Alastair Irving

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] RStan: single elements are not coerced to arrays of length 1
parts:
It's a feature, not a bug, in the sense that we did it on purpose for
error checking. I agree that it's inconvenient that R conflates size-1
vectors and scalars.

- Bob
